issues: The same full-page screenshot was cross-blurred with itself, so mid-handoff read as the whole frame going soft with no sense of two layers
The page's native 16-17px text left nothing large to read, so it was unclear which section was in view
The top and bottom bokeh bands were blurred copies of the same texture, faking shallow depth with a mask
A full-frame pale grey page with no stage, light or colour hierarchy
changes: Warm sand look; two sections of the long page become two depth planes: B already sits behind A at the start (0.9x, 14px blur, desaturated), with its third card showing through A's empty slot

Rack focus: A passes through the focal plane toward the lens (1 to 1.08, drifting up 80px, blurring to 16px, ease-in fade) while B pulls into focus 3f later (14px to 0, full saturation, rising 40px), only fully sharp once A's ghost is gone

Each section gets a 112px title with a terracotta mono index (01 Agents & Dev Tools to 03 Perception & Sensing), focused with its own plane and 2f behind it, so the two titles never blur over each other
Real card textures laid out at 1.42x so the text reads; a heavily blurred far page layer and an out-of-focus foreground card at the lower right drift with parallax to sell shallow depth
120f timeline: 28f A hold, handoff 28-55, then a 65f B hold with a slow upward drift and 1% breathing
